subject: Re: [rhipe] rhread with large key value pairs

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] rhread with large key value pairs
parts:
Good question, currently, that version you have is limited to a single k/v pair of 128MB (or maybe 256).
0.73 will have an option. Note, however, the protobuf author has concerns with large values.
( i think 0.73 will have a 1G or 1.5G limit)


On Tue, Jan 15, 2013 at 1:48 PM, Fatman <hath...@gmail.com> wrote:
I am using 0.72 of Rhipe and have created some large key value pairs.  I realize I could create smaller key value pairs.  However, is there a parameter in Rhipe that I could use to allow me to read in large key value pairs?

rhread("mydatapath",max=6,skip="/_", type="map")
RHIPE: Read 6 pairs occupying 527.333 MB, deserializing
Error in rhuz(r[[2]]) :
  PB ERROR[LOGLEVEL_ERROR](google/protobuf/io/coded_stream.cc:156) A protocol message was rejected because it was too big (more than 268435456 bytes).  To increase the limit (or to disable these warnings), see CodedInputStream::SetTotalBytesLimit() in google/protobuf/io/coded_stream.h.
